implementation_kind: original mlx2 serving and APCv2 defect corrections
license: Apache-2.0; original project code, no external implementation copied
modifications: Preserve the shared or tenant/media base semantic namespace inside an explicitly tagged adapter numerical-law wrapper, so APCv2 can classify and admit its own persisted identities after restart; disabled adapter-law identities remain unchanged
Ignore nonfinite, overflowing, negative or native-size-exceeding MLX2_CACHE_LIMIT_GIB values before allocator configuration; retain finite valid byte semantics

Validate resident recurrent-state payloads against the selected codec policy before publication, matching the existing disk admission contract; refuse malformed or foreign encoded records and expose refusal counts
Reject unknown codec tags at direct decode rather than interpreting them as the current encoding

Carry actual decoded recurrent-leaf counts on the request-private restore and APCLookup, then accumulate admitted request restores locally; dense-only warm KV hits no longer claim recurrent-codec observed use and attribution never uses global counter deltas

validation.coverage: Actual disk park/restart/resume/cache-state equality across shared/tenant and media scopes; identity refusal across different laws; startup environment bounds; malformed resident codec publication refusal; real cold/warm tiny dense and GDN ServingEngine restores with actual recurrent leaves; persistence, recovery, streaming, lifecycle and structured-output integration checks

scope: Reproduced defects in the 48-hour source sweep; CPU integration validation does not qualify every audited route or device path
